entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I was hoping I could make a return. I just don't know if I can.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, may I have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number 788-4B2. I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
Okay, Sarah, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Pro-Cycle jersey. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's the wrong size. I saved up for this jersey and was so excited, but it's just way too tight. I feel terrible about it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was really counting on getting that money back for holiday gifts.
I'm very sorry to hear the fit wasn't right. Getting the right size is so important for comfort on a ride. Let me just review the policy for your order to see what we can do.
Okay, I've checked the details. I see you received the item 59 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel.
Oh, really? So... so I can return it? I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for you right now. We can either issue a full refund to your original payment method, or I could help you set up an exchange for a larger size if you'd prefer.
Oh, that's such a relief! A refund would be perfect, thank you so much. You have no idea how much I appreciate this.

Of course, Sarah. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label. Please repackage the jersey, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
That's wonderful. Thank you again, Isaac. You've been a huge help.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
